meta_title: Why Choose SN Cleaning Services for After Builders Cleaning
meta_description: HEPA filtered vacuums, every surface from vents to drawers, our own DBS checked team. Why London and Essex trust SN Cleaning Services after building work.
h1: The work is finished. Now let's get rid of the dust.
intro: You've lived with noise, dust sheets and trades for weeks, maybe months. The builders have gone, and every surface has a fine grey film that seems to come back the minute you wipe it. This is the clean that turns a building site back into a home, or into a property you can hand over with confidence.

understand.heading: Why building dust is a different job
paragraphs: Building dust isn't like household dust. It's fine enough to sit on top of door frames, inside brand new drawers, in light fittings and along every sill, and a damp cloth just smears it into a paste. If you've tried tackling it yourself, you'll know how it keeps settling again.
There's usually a date hanging over it too: a move in, a new tenant, a sale completing, a client walking round for the handover. You need it done properly once, not three times.

The people who call us are homeowners at the end of an extension or a new kitchen, landlords between tenants after a refurb, and builders and developers who want the job to look finished when they hand it over.

items.title: Equipment made for fine dust
items.text: We use HEPA filtered vacuums designed to capture fine construction dust, rather than blowing it back into the air to land on the surfaces we've just cleaned.

items.title: Top to bottom, in the right order
items.text: Walls, skirting, light fittings, vents and sills first, then cabinets and drawers inside and out, and floors last, so nothing falls onto a surface that's already done.

items.title: The finishing details
items.text: Internal windows and frames cleaned, and paint splashes and tape residue removed where possible. These are the things you notice when the dust has gone.

items.title: Straight about what's included
items.text: Packaging and small debris are cleared as part of the clean. Large waste removal, like skips or old fixtures, is arranged separately, and we tell you that up front.

items.title: Priced on the actual job
items.text: After builders cleaning starts from £179. Your quote is based on the size of the property and the work that was done, so a single room refit isn't priced like a full renovation.

items.title: Before and after photos
items.text: Our cleaners photograph the property before and after, and you get a private link with Before and After folders. Useful for your own records, or to share with a client or landlord.

process.heading: How an after builders clean works

steps.title: Tell us about the work
steps.text: What was done, how many rooms were affected, the size of the property and any date you're working towards.

steps.title: Get your quote
steps.text: We price it on the size and the work, and you agree the price before anything is booked.

steps.title: Book once the trades are out
steps.text: Choose a day after the last trade has finished and the property is clear to access, so new dust isn't being made while we clean.

steps.title: The clean
steps.text: The team takes before photos, cleans from the ceiling fittings down to the floors with professional products, then takes after photos for your private link.

steps.title: Final check
steps.text: Every room is spot checked before we leave. If anything isn't right, tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back.

promise.heading: No risk on your side
paragraphs: The price is agreed before we book the clean, based on what you've told us about the property and the work. If you're not happy with any part of the cleaning, tell us within 24 hours and we'll return to re clean it free of charge.
Every cleaner is from our own team: trained, insured and DBS checked, never a subcontractor. That matters in a newly finished property full of fresh paint, new fittings and expensive surfaces.

proof.heading: Experience you can see in the detail
proof.paragraph: SN Cleaning Services started as a regular domestic cleaning company, then spent four years doing almost nothing but end of tenancy cleans, 7,549 of them over 12 years. An empty property inspected against an inventory is very close to an empty property after building work: every sill, frame and cupboard gets looked at. We bring that same habit to after builders cleans across London and Essex, from our office at 15A Shenfield Road, Brentwood.

faqs.question: Why does the price vary so much between jobs?
faqs.answer: Because the work varies. A full renovation leaves dust in every room, while a bathroom refit may only affect part of the home. After builders cleaning starts from £179, and your quote is based on the size of the property and the work that was done.

faqs.question: What do you need to know to give me a quote?
faqs.answer: The size of the property, which rooms were worked on, what kind of work it was, such as plastering, a new kitchen or a full renovation, and any date you need it finished by. Photos of the rooms help us price it accurately.

faqs.question: How long does an after builders clean take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the size of the property and how much dust and residue the work left behind. A single room refit is much quicker than a whole house renovation. We'll tell you what to expect when we send your quote.

faqs.question: Will one clean get rid of all the dust?
faqs.answer: A thorough clean removes the dust that's there on the day. Very fine dust can sometimes drift out of vents or gaps for a little while afterwards. If something we cleaned isn't right, tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back to it.

faqs.question: Do the builders need to be completely finished?
faqs.answer: Ideally, yes. If trades are still sanding, drilling or painting, new dust lands on surfaces we've just cleaned. Book once the last trade has finished, and tell us if any small jobs are still planned.

faqs.question: Do I need power and water on for the clean?
faqs.answer: Yes, please. We need electricity for our HEPA filtered vacuums and lights, and running water for the kitchen, bathroom and floors. If either isn't connected yet, tell us when you ask for a quote.

faqs.question: Can you clean just one room after a refit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us which rooms were worked on and whether dust spread into the rest of the home, and we'll quote for what's actually needed. Dust often travels further than people expect, so it is worth checking the rooms next door.

faqs.question: Do you clean inside new cupboards and drawers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cabinets and drawers are cleaned inside and out, because building dust gets everywhere, including into units that were only just fitted. It means you can unpack straight into them.

faqs.question: Can you remove paint splashes and tape marks?
faqs.answer: We remove paint splashes and tape residue where possible. Some paint on certain surfaces can't be taken off safely without damaging the finish, and if that's the case we'll tell you rather than risk it.

faqs.question: Do you clean the windows?
faqs.answer: Internal windows and frames are cleaned as part of the job, including the dust and residue on sills and tracks. For anything else, such as outside windows, ask our team when you request a quote.

faqs.question: What about dust in carpets and soft furnishings?
faqs.answer: Our HEPA filtered vacuums lift fine dust from carpets and upholstery as part of the clean. If carpets need a deeper clean after the work, professional carpet cleaning is a separate service you can book too.

faqs.question: Do you clean light fittings, vents and extractor fans?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dust is removed from light fittings, vents and sills throughout the property. These spots trap a lot of building dust and are easy to miss, so they're on every after builders clean.

faqs.question: Do you work for builders and developers?
faqs.answer: Yes. We clean for homeowners, landlords, builders and developers. If you're handing a project to a client, tell us the handover date and anything they're likely to look at closely.

faqs.question: Can a landlord book this before new tenants move in?
faqs.answer: Yes. After a refurb, an after builders clean gets the property ready for photos, viewings or a new tenancy. Tell us when the work finishes and when the property needs to be ready.

faqs.question: Do I need to be there during the clean?
faqs.answer: No, as long as we can get in. Tell us when you book how we'll access the property, and whether anyone else, like a site manager, will be there. We will let you know when it is finished.

faqs.question: What should I do before you arrive?
faqs.answer: Make sure tools, materials and large waste have been removed, and the trades have finished. Let us know about anything freshly painted or sealed that should be left alone, and any surfaces needing special care.

faqs.question: Do you bring your own products and equipment?
faqs.answer: Yes. We bring professional products and equipment, including HEPA filtered vacuums for building dust and my own Limescale Remover for any new taps and tiles that need it. You do not need to provide anything.

faqs.question: Are your cleaners insured and DBS checked?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every cleaner is part of our own team, trained by us, insured and DBS checked. We never use subcontractors, so you always know who is working in your property.

faqs.question: Will I get before and after photos?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our cleaners photograph the property before and after the clean, and you get a private link with Before and After folders. They can be useful to share with a client, landlord or agent.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the clean?
faqs.answer: Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean anything that isn't right, free of charge. Let us know which rooms and what you've noticed, and photos help us sort it quickly.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We carry out after builders cleaning across London and Essex, from our office in Brentwood. Enter your postcode in the quote form to check your address. If you are not sure, ask our team and they will check for you.

faqs.question: Can I change the date if the builders overrun?
faqs.answer: Building work does overrun. Contact our team as soon as you know, and they'll explain the options for moving your booking. The earlier you let us know, the easier it is to find a new date that still fits your handover or move in.

faqs.question: Can I speak to someone before I book?
faqs.answer: Of course. Our customer support team is available Monday to Friday from 7am to 10pm, and Saturday and Sunday from 8am to 5pm, and can talk through the work and your dates.

faqs.question: Is it worth booking a clean before I move furniture back in?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you can. An empty room lets us reach every skirting board, sill and corner, and clean the floors properly from wall to wall. Once furniture is back, dust trapped behind and under it is much harder to reach.
